statement: For every subgroup H of Homeo(S1), the inclusion of its centralizer in Homeo+(S1) induces an injection on fundamental groups into Z, with image in the orientation-character invariants. Every winding-zero based loop has an explicit conjugacy-natural contraction obtained from the line median formula. A null-homotopic plane homeomorphism loop preserving a Jordan curve has restriction winding zero, by an exact two-point configuration-space comparison.
depends_on: C.27 median contraction; covering lifts for circle homeomorphisms; Schoenflies theorem; explicit difference-angle winding identity; C.12 canonical lift for the application
manuscript_passages: 23; folios 140–141; scans 279–281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; exact partial reduction for C.12
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None: circle groups, the comparison map, and plane-loop hypotheses are explicitly specified.
notes: The commutator of the based lifted loop with any lift of a commuting circle homeomorphism is a continuous integer translation, hence identically trivial. Median naturality handles orientation reversal. The plane restriction winding equals the winding of the difference direction of two evaluated points. C.34 subsequently proves continuity on the full nonopen locus. C.35 gives an exact obstruction to extending that particular median prescription, and C.36 supplies compatible alternatives on finite unions of dimension-two proper-action closures. The remaining global requirements are kept in C.12.
